in_marathi.name: Geeta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song, Chant, Verse
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geeta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geeta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gitam', meaning 'song' or 'chant'. It is also the name of a sacred Hindu text, the Bhagavad Gita, which is a collection of verses from the Indian epic Mahabharata. The Bhagavad Gita is a significant spiritual text in Hinduism and is considered to be a guide for living a virtuous life. The name Geeta represents wisdom, knowledge, and the power of the divine.
